summary: Max Verstappen won the Chinese Grand Prix Sprint from P4 on the grid, 13.0s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Sergio Perez completing the podium.
Esteban Ocon made the biggest climb, from P17 to P13.
Fernando Alonso had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P20.
There were 1 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 0 times.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 15 points over Sergio Perez.
